verdict.rationale: Better Auth's own MCP plugin is documented to make an app an OAuth authorization server and protected resource for MCP clients, which is the core of this story. The homepage also advertises MCP auth for AI agents, and the JWT plugin exposes a JWKS endpoint for token verification. missing for 10: explicit evidence of spec compliance with the MCP authorization spec (e.g. PKCE, dynamic client registration, protected-resource metadata), documented scope issuance and enforcement on tokens, and independent or hands-on corroboration of remote agents connecting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can put a spec-compliant OAuth authorization flow in front of my MCP server so remote agents connect with scoped, verifiable tokens

citations.quote: The MCP plugin lets your app act as an OAuth authorization server and protected resource for Model Context Protocol clients.
Auth for AI agents. MCP auth, token exchange, and agent delegation.
The JWT plugin provides endpoints to retrieve a JWT token and a JWKS endpoint to verify the token.
